Long, straight charcoal grey hair with a centered part and long bangs framing the face. Cold, narrow deep crimson eyes. Apparent age is a late teenager with a stoic face. Slender, athletic build. Signature outfit is a dark grey and black military-style dress with red accents and a high collar. Signature details include a black peaked military cap and a long, mechanical grey rigging system with cannons attached to the back.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
